headline: Northern Front Ignites as Clashes Rock Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Since the last edition, sharp clashes across the northern theater have yielded fresh base shifts in Weathered Expanse, Callahan's Passage, and Stlican Shelf. Weathered Expanse remains the war's most volatile sector, logging four base transitions in the past two hours alone amid nearly 2,800 casualties centered on Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, leaving two strategic bases abandoned in no-man's-land. In Callahan's Passage, heavy back-and-forth fighting around The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post brought two base actions and almost 2,900 combined casualties over the last two hours. Stlican Shelf has also reignited with two recent base exchanges involving Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, leaving five strongpoints under Colonial control, three Warden, and one neutral. Meanwhile, fierce attrition continues without fresh territorial flips in Mooring County, Nevish Line, and Palantine Berm, each soaking up substantial casualties under steady enlistment. The southern mainland and island chains remain completely quiet.
